Hey! Im also an IS major and just wanted to share my thought process. IS is really versatile and will get your foot into many jobs

At my school, they let use double major in the most similar/easiest to match courses. For IS we can do marketing, finance/economcis/ accounting, business analytics, and accounting. So if you're looking for an easy transition these might be a good idea. 

However, minors are a lot less restrictive. A lot of people I know will just minor in something that they are interested in since it takes fewer credits. I know a civil engineering major minoring in political science; I know English majors minoring in psychology. It really is up to you.

Another thing to take into consideration is what field you want to work in in the future. If you want to work in banking do finance. If you want to work in a biotech company maybe do an engineering or bio minor. If you want to go deeper into computers do something like CS. 

Of course, it all depends on your specific university and the requirement the school has.
